effect_description_eng:
＜Material Save 1＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may place 1 card in this Digimon's DigiXros requirements from this Digimon's digivolution cards under 1 of your Tamers.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, if DigiXrosing with 2 cards, you may delete 1 play cost 3 or lower Digimon or Tamer.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with [Knightmon] in its text from under your Tamers without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with [Knightmon] in its text from your trash without paying the cost.
xros_req:
DigiXros Requirements [DigiXros -2] [SkullKnightmon] x [DeadlyAxemon] 
When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
